claim.statement: The publisher's README at tag rust-v0.90.0 describes Codex CLI as a coding agent that runs locally and names npm, Homebrew cask and platform-specific GitHub release binaries as distribution paths.

source.title: OpenAI Codex README at rust-v0.90.0
source.locator: Opening description and Quickstart — Installing and running Codex CLI

limitations: The README is a publisher description; local execution and each distribution path were not tested.
The named platforms are the README's highlighted archive examples, not an exhaustive supported-platform inventory.
unknowns: Which distribution path, platform build and executable a particular user invokes is unknown.
Homebrew and npm registry metadata, transitive installation behavior and runtime file layout were not inspected.
